title: lean-business-case artifact schema
description: Validates the Markdown Lean Business Case artifact for an Epic. Authored in the Epic Lean Business Case practice; challenged by @enterprise-architect and @security-expert; weighed by the Central Supervisor at the ★ Epic Gate.

__path.description: Workspace-relative path of the artifact file, injected by the orchestration harness (not authored in frontmatter).

__kind.description: Artifact-kind discriminator injected by the harness; must equal x-artifact.kind.

__artifact_id.description: Stable artifact id injected by the harness, derived from the file and frontmatter.

__frontmatter_present.description: Harness assertion that YAML frontmatter was found and parsed; always true for a valid artifact.

__sections.description: Artifact body sections keyed by their `## ` heading — one property per template section; the value is the raw Markdown under that heading.

Problem & opportunity.description: The systemic problem, who has it, why now.

Solution hypothesis (MVP).description: The smallest Feature set that tests the hypothesis.

WSJF.description: Weighted Shortest Job First scoring block.

Leading & lagging indicators.description: Early measurable signals and outcome metrics.

Cost / effort estimate.description: Rough order of magnitude; informs Participatory Budgeting.

Enabler / runway dependency.description: Architectural-runway items this Epic consumes or requires.

Pivot / persevere / stop criteria.description: Evidence that would change the decision.

Challenge findings.description: EA / Security adversarial notes, folded in before the ★ Epic Gate.

__body.description: Raw Markdown body of the artifact (everything after the frontmatter), injected by the harness.

epic.description: Id of the Epic this lean business case shapes (e.g. E-1).

status.description: Authoring lifecycle of the business case.

fundingState.description: Funding posture proposed by the case (set by Participatory Budgeting).

slug.description: URL-safe slug for the artifact (e.g. e-1-lbc).

title.description: Human-readable title for the lean business case.

workItemRelations.description: Typed work-item relations (dependsOn / enables / relatedTo / supersedes).

wsjf.description: Weighted Shortest Job First scoring block.

openItems.description: Clarification + challenge ledger (a blocking open entry halts the relevant gate).

cost.description: Token-cost accounting block (see the cost definition).

github.description: GitHub Projects sync envelope, filled by portfolio/_sync (null when authoring).

sources.description: Derivation provenance (narrowed subtype of the base contract's sources): refs to the upstream artifact(s) this lean-business-case was built from. Allowed source kinds: epic, epic-enabler.
